events.title: US National Weather Service Active Alerts
events.region: West Humboldt Basin - Pershing County; Lahontan Basin - Churchill and Eastern Mineral Counties
events.source_name: US National Weather Service Active Alerts
events.summary:
* Affected Area...Fire Weather Zone 423 West Humboldt Basin in
Pershing County, Fire Weather Zone 429 Lahontan Basin
including Churchill and Eastern Mineral Counties.

* Winds...Southwest to west winds 15 to 25 mph with gusts up to 40
mph. Winds shift northerly/northwesterly in the evening and
overnight.

* Humidity...As low as 12 to 17 percent in the afternoon.

* Duration...4 to 7 hours.

* Impacts...The combination of gusty winds and low humidity can
cause fire to rapidly grow in size and intensity before first
responders can contain them.

events.title: US National Weather Service Active Alerts
events.region: Coastal Flagler; Northeast Coastal St. Johns; Southeast Coastal St. Johns
events.source_name: US National Weather Service Active Alerts
events.summary:
* WHAT...For the Coastal Flood Advisory, minor coastal flooding.
For the High Surf Advisory, large breaking waves of 6 to 9 feet.
For the High Rip Current Risk, dangerous rip currents.

* WHERE...Coastal Flagler, Northeast Coastal St. Johns and
Southeast Coastal St. Johns Counties.

* WHEN...For the Coastal Flood Advisory, until 5 PM EDT this
afternoon. For the High Surf Advisory, until 2 AM EDT
Saturday. For the High Rip Current Risk, through late Saturday
night.

* IMPACTS...Flooding of lots, parks, and roads with only
isolated road closures expected. Dangerous swimming and
surfing conditions and localized beach erosion. Rip currents
can sweep even the best swimmers away from shore into deeper
water.
